title: AION 2 DPS Meter: NotMeter Setup and Damage Records
description: Use NotMeter's AION 2 damage records, install Npcap and compare DPS or nDPS. Check desktop region support and account policy before combat capture.
summary: NotMeter is a third-party AION 2 DPS meter and combat-record website. Website searches and desktop capture are separate; current desktop compatibility is unconfirmed.
quickAnswer: NotMeter provides third-party AION 2 damage records. Its Windows setup is Npcap, then the extracted NotMeter ZIP. Website character search is available, but current desktop capture compatibility is unconfirmed; check region support and account policy before installing.
